title: rpl/dodag.py: parents dict unbounded growth allows DoS - Line 344 adds parent candidates with no MAX_PARENTS limit. Attacker sending DIOs from spoofed neighbor_ids can exhaust memory. Fix: add MAX_PARENTS constant and evict lowest-quality candidates when limit reached.
close_reason: MAX_PARENTS=16 (matches Rust MAX_PARENT_CANDIDATES), _make_room_for evicts strictly-worse by select_parent's own path_cost ordering, preferred_parent exempt, no churn on equal/worse; 5 tests added. rpl 812 green. Rust-side adopt-better-parent gap filed separately.
